en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby who said,
‘The woman divorced by Al-Khul’a is not to be provided for’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “He (the Imam) ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
woman of al-Khul‘ does not receive any benefits.’”
